meta.summary: RadioReference: hide the Premium upsell, sign-up buttons and featured product; dim or hide news cards; hero art and stats toggles.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on radioreference.com/. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (the machine ran out of memory/network when retried; the page uses a `navtoggle` hamburger and a `mobile-only` nav item, so phone markup is the same document), the database (/db/), forums and wiki (separate hosts), and logged-in pages.

LIVE counts on Home: premium-section desktop home 1; hero-ctas desktop home 1; featured-product desktop home 1; news-dim desktop home 2; news-hide desktop home 2; hero-art desktop home 1; site-stats desktop home 1. All selectors are readable class names of a hand-written template (rrb-prem, rrb-trio, card prod, heroart, statgrid); no hashed classes. The ads and cookie rules of 1.0.0 match nothing: no ins, iframe or cookie dialog was present.

Choice: News and updates cards Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35). The Featured Product card is the affiliate-style ad; Log In (`a.hdr-login`, `a.cta-login`) is never hidden.

NOT verified: phone layout, the database pages and their ads, Broadcastify and wiki hosts (other domains), logged-in UI.
